cohort: 180 randomly selected pregnant participants presenting in spontaneous labor at the maternity unit of a Federal Teaching Hospital in Nigeria.
finding: There was no significant association between maternal height and the mode of delivery, however, a significant association was found between neonatal birthweight and the route of delivery.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between maternal height and mode of delivery, but a significant association was observed between neonatal birthweight and route of delivery.
cross-section timing: At the time of presentation in spontaneous labor at the maternity unit.
birth_weight: Measured for all participants, but no specific weight range for inclusion was mentioned.
